acceptanceCriteria: A producer command emits a cem/1.0 map whose only criteria are plain-form bindings, from inputs that need no Corvint Tasks store.
The emitted map ACCEPTs on both consumers on a repository with no .taskman/, and re-produces protocol/cem-1.0/stable/neutral-criterion/stable.json byte-identically from its recipe inputs.
docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md records the producer under CEM-V1-083 or a new requirement, and the pilot-kit walkthrough replaces the hand-assembly step.
body: Observed 2026-10-12 during the V1-1263 walkthrough (docs/build-log/2026-10-12-cem-neutral-criterion-walkthrough.md, step 8). CEM-V1-083 lets a cem/1.0 criterion binding take the plain form {id, criterionIndex, criterionSha256, evidenceId}, and both consumers accept it, but no producer emits it: corvint-cem-candidate assemble-stable --experimental accepts only the Tasks-bound cem-stable-assembly/1 request (ticketId, attemptId, capture, verification, snapshotHeadArtifact required) and refuses 'incomplete stable assembly request' without them. The public case protocol/cem-1.0/stable/neutral-criterion/stable.json and the walkthrough map were hand-assembled by a scratch script. Expected: a documented producer path emits a plain-criterion cem/1.0 map from a cem/0.x map plus a runner receipt on a repository with no .taskman/, so kill criterion K4 (a stranger produces and verifies a map on a non-Corvint repository in one engineer-day) can be observed. Actual: only hand assembly. Related: V1-1275 (deterministic cem/0.x -> cem/1.0 converter) may cover the map conversion; this ticket is the plain request form for assemble-stable (or an equivalent corvint cem verb) that binds the evidence span as the criterion and the runner receipt, with the CHANGES/identity rules of internal/cem/wire/stable.go.
title: cem/1.0: no producer emits the plain (provider-neutral) criterion form; assemble-stable requires the Tasks-bound request
